definitions.short: agreeableness , i.e. delight , suitableness , splendor or grace
definitions.full: H5278. noam נֹ֫עַם noun masculine Psa 90:17 delightfulness, pleasantness (Ecclus תירוש נועם Ecclesiasticus 32:6); — ׳נ absolute Zech 11:7 4 t.; construct Psa 27:4 ; 90:17 ; — 1 delightfulness of ׳׃י contemplated in temple Psa 27:4 , shewn in his favour, נ ׳וִיהִי אדניעָ֗֗֗לֵינוּ 90:17 . 2 name of one of two symbolic staves Zech 11:7 , 10 . 3 pleasantness , as defining Genitive: ׳דַּרְכֵינֿ Prov 3:17 ; ׳אִמְרֵינֿ 15:26 ; 16:24 .
